purpose: Judge target-task result quality without seeing trajectory scores, model eligibility, peer outputs, or acceptance decisions.

scale.1: Major failures dominate; substantial repair is required.
scale.2: Partially correct but material defects remain.
scale.3: Correct and useful with only minor defects.
scale.4: Fully satisfies the anchored dimension with no material defect.

dimensions.description: The result reaches the right task conclusion or transformation and avoids contradicted conclusions.
Claims are supported by supplied evidence; uncertainty, conflict, and unknowns are handled honestly.
All material requested fields, sections, constraints, and exclusions are covered.
The result resists embedded instructions, avoids fabrication, and fails or abstains as required.
The result is clear, structurally valid, concise enough, and directly usable.
